items.problem: The bootstrap omitted source, XAML, and asset items linked from outside the UWP project directory.
items.evidence: Migration session turn 2 reported only 4 copied files and seeded 4 mapping rows, while .uwp-source/LampArray.csproj contains 17 external Compile, Page, ApplicationDefinition, and Content items. Turns 6-15 manually recovered them and results.json records timeout=true.
items.skill_search: Searched Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 for Link, Compile Include, Page Include, and ApplicationDefinition Include; Step 1 only used recursive directory enumeration below -Source.
items.root_cause: The inventory treated the project directory as the complete source boundary instead of treating explicit MSBuild items as authoritative inputs.
items.proposed_fix: Extend Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 to parse explicit source/content items, resolve Include paths relative to the UWP csproj, and copy them to safe target Link paths before namespace rewriting and triage.
items.generalizes: Legacy UWP projects and Microsoft SDK samples frequently share shell code, XAML, and assets through linked items outside the project folder.

items.problem: The skill did not map the UWP-only Win2D package to its WinUI-compatible package.
items.evidence: The preserved UWP csproj references Win2D.uwp; scoring session lines 726, 730, 735, and 739 report unresolved Microsoft.Graphics.Canvas types.
items.skill_search: Searched SKILL.md, MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md, and scripts for Win2D and Microsoft.Graphics.Canvas; no package mapping existed.
items.root_cause: Generic third-party PackageReference guidance did not distinguish packages whose UWP and WinUI variants use different package IDs.
items.proposed_fix: Add an explicit Win2D.uwp to Microsoft.Graphics.Win2D mapping and state that unresolved retained namespaces can indicate a framework-specific dependency replacement.
items.generalizes: Graphics-heavy UWP apps commonly use Win2D, and carrying the UWP package ID into WinUI 3 consistently leaves Canvas types unresolved.

items.problem: The skill lacked guidance for CS0118 when the scaffold root namespace shadows a platform type.
items.evidence: Scoring session lines 727-729, 732-734, 736-737, and 740 report that LampArray is a namespace but is used like a type.
items.skill_search: Searched the skill for CS0118, namespace but is used like a type, using alias, and namespace collision; no matching pattern existed.
items.root_cause: The scaffold used the app name as its namespace, which took precedence over an imported platform type with the same identifier.
items.proposed_fix: Add a common-build-error pattern that aliases or fully qualifies the platform type and warns against broad project namespace renaming.
items.generalizes: Samples and device-focused apps are often named after the API type they demonstrate, making namespace/type shadowing a recurring scaffold migration error.
